query: How can I locate my past traffic infractions through an online search?
reference_answer:
Traffic Violation History:
To view your traffic violation history online, visit the Tamil Nadu Police Department's official website or the e-Challan portal. Click on "Check Traffic Violation" and enter your vehicle number or driving license number to access your records.
answer: To find past traffic infractions, visit your state’s Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) website or use a DMV-approved mobile app. They often have a section for viewing previous traffic tickets. [Document 1]
